en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a busy waterfront town scene with many people gathered along a street and near the harbor. Flags and pennants are strung across the area, and several boats and low rocky islands can be seen in the background. Traditional wooden houses line the right side of the image. The word "Bovallstrand." is printed at the bottom left of the postcard.
